description: This file contains functions for generating sales partner target variance reports based on item groups, including data retrieval, column setup, and data preparation logic within the ERPNext system.

methods.name: get_data_column
methods.description: Generates columns and data for the sales target variance report based on filters and partner doctype.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Retrieves sales data and item groups, then prepares the report data.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Defines the structure of report columns based on filters and period list.

methods.name: prepare_data
methods.description: Processes raw data into structured report rows with targets, achievements, and variances.

methods.name: get_actual_data
methods.description: Fetches actual sales data from the database based on filters, item groups, and date fields.

methods.name: get_parents_data
methods.description: Retrieves target details for the specified partner doctype.
